lattice_source.uncertainty_status: not reported in accessible abstract; not zero
lattice_source.source_gate: primary abstract; campaign-authorized extrapolation; pointwise uncertainty unavailable

profile.force_stopping_rule: GPAW maximum all-atom force change <0.0001 eV/A across last two checked cycles; not site stationarity

response.scope: One actual all-atom column; not a full Hessian or reciprocal bond law
response.all_ion_sum_scope: Acoustic diagnostic for the full-ion source column, not an H-only stiffness
response.stationarity: Registered-site finite-step tangent only; F0 is retained, no relaxed-minimum claim

coupling.normalization: Fit mean_pulling_Jdd per existing bond; lattice occupancy is applied once. Full-reference equivalent is diagnostic, not an unfolded shell.
coupling.interpretation: H-only heterogeneous column sum, metals fixed; NOT a global Gamma eigenmode, not an all-ion acoustic sum, not an unscreened reciprocal bond law
coupling.folding: Each occupied periodic H site once. Source-image terms remain folded in onsite. Nearest-image offsets label finite-cell shells; half-cell ties use numpy.rint. No boundary multiplicity replication, missing neighbours absent.

limitations: No GPW/PAW bytes required for this frozen readout. No spatial inversion reconstruction, no quartic/well fit, no relaxation, no full Hessian or global Gamma mode. Finite-step SCF, mesh, finite-cell and lattice-source errors are not bounded here.
